title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (pp. 94–96). X is a space stratified by a poset I, with strata X_i^*, closed unions X_J^* and closures X_i. For each i, (94) V_i = V(X_i^*, X) is a 'prévoisinage tubulaire' (pre-tubular neighbourhood) of the stratum, and the inclusion X_i^* → V_i is a homotopy equivalence. The previous page showed two things: V_i ∩ X_j^* ≠ ∅ iff i ≤ j for a dense and faithful stratification; and (96), for X metrisable, V_i ∩ V_j ≠ ∅ implies that i and j are comparable (the converse holds for faithful stratifications). It then set (97) V_ij = V_i ∩ V_j.

This page does the bookkeeping.
- For i, j incomparable (X metrisable), V_ij = ∅, so there is nothing to say.
- For i = j, V_ii = V_i, so nothing new is introduced.
- Since V_ij = V_ji, only i < j is needed.
- Generally one sets (98) V_{i_0…i_n} = V_{i_0} ∩ … ∩ V_{i_n}. One restricts to the case where {i_0,…,i_n} is a flag (chain) of I, since otherwise the intersection is empty, written strictly increasing i_0 < … < i_n to avoid redundancy.

These V_d, for d ∈ Drap(I) (the poset of nonempty chains, i.e. the barycentric subdivision sd(I)), are declared the elementary 'building pieces'. A marginal addition extends this to parts Z of them, the V^Z of the next page. Many other objects are to be built from them by (finite, if I is finite) limits/colimits along the evident semi-simplicial maps: face inclusions V_d ⊂ V_{d'} for d' ⊂ d.

The next page confirms the gluing is a colimit: V_J = ∪_{j∈J} V_j = lim→_{d∈Drap(J)} V_d. It also asks whether the restricted pieces V^Z_d → V_d are homotopy equivalences.

In modern terms, the stratified space is encoded by a contravariant diagram on sd(I), d ↦ V_d. For a conically or homotopically stratified space, V_{i_0<…<i_n} is homotopy equivalent to the generalized homotopy link of the flag. This is the programme of 'déploiement' (unfolding) of stratified spaces.
errors: The emptiness of V_ij for incomparable i, j is not automatic. It needs the tubular pre-neighbourhoods to be chosen small enough, using metrisability as in (96). The page relies on that standing hypothesis.

'lim' should be a direct limit (colimit/union), as the next page's formula V_J = lim→ V_d shows. For the gluing to be homotopically meaningful one needs cofibrancy/excision conditions on the covering by the V_d (they are not all open), which are not discussed here. The next page itself flags the related homotopy equivalence (100) as '? à vérifier!'.

ideas.what: Intersections of tubular neighbourhoods of strata are nonempty only along chains of the stratification poset; index the pieces by strictly increasing flags
ideas.modern_name: Diagram over the subdivision sd(P) (poset of chains); nerve of the covering by stratum neighbourhoods
ideas.usually_credited_to: Mather / Thom (control data, 1970); later homotopy-link diagrams by Quinn (1988), Douteau, Haine, Lurie (Higher Algebra, App. A)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme only alludes to a 'dévissage' of stratified structures via tubular neighbourhoods, without this formalism

ideas.what: Elementary building pieces V_d (d ∈ Drap(I)) with semi-simplicial face maps, reconstructing V_J and other objects as finite colimits
ideas.modern_name: Reconstruction of a stratified homotopy type from the sd(P)-diagram of generalized homotopy links

ideas.what: Elimination of degenerate and incomparable indices (V_ii = V_i, symmetry, empty for non-chains)
ideas.modern_name: Passing from the full Čech nerve to the non-degenerate chain complex / semi-simplicial nerve

missed.claim: In 1981–82 Grothendieck explicitly organises a stratified space as a contravariant diagram on Drap(I) = sd(I) of intersections of stratum neighbourhoods, taken as the elementary building pieces of a 'déploiement'. This anticipates the now-standard description of stratified homotopy types as sd(P)-diagrams of generalized homotopy links (Douteau, Haine). That literature does not cite this manuscript.
missed.quote: on se bornera en règle générale au cas où {i_0,…,i_n} est un drapeau … Les parties sont les "pièces de construction" élémentaires … compte tenu des morphismes semi-simpliciaux évidents entre les V_d (d=(i_0,…,i_n)∈Drap(I))
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historical priority, and a point-set geometric model in which homotopy links are actual subspaces (intersections of tubular pre-neighbourhoods). This could give concrete comparison maps in the sd(P)-diagram approach. The parallel was likely known in spirit through Mather/Thom control data.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is mostly bookkeeping. The idea of indexing neighbourhood intersections by flags and treating them as semi-simplicial building blocks closely prefigures later sd(P)-diagram models of stratified spaces, but it is a natural step given control-data theory.
transcription_corrections: 'X irréductible[?]' should read 'X métrisable', consistent with (96) on the previous page.
'$\varprojlim$[?]' is an underlined 'lim'. In view of (101) on the next page this means direct limit (colimit), $\varinjlim$.
'pour une construction des tas[?] d'entre[?]' probably reads 'pour une construction des tas d'autres' (i.e. 'for the construction of lots of others').
The margin note appears to refer to parts Z and the restricted pieces V_{i_0…i_n}∩Z, anticipating (99) on the next page. The words 'deux-à-deux' are doubtful.
